items.question: How many passengers do the vans seat?
items.answer: Up to 14 passengers, depending on the specific vehicle configuration.

items.question: Where are the vans available?
items.answer: Throughout the Rent With Heldy South Florida service area, including Miami and Fort Lauderdale.

items.question: Can I rent a van for a cruise trip?
items.answer: Yes. These vans can be useful for large groups traveling before or after cruises from PortMiami and Port Everglades.

items.question: Can sports teams rent the vans?
items.answer: Yes. Passenger vans are well suited for teams, coaches, families and organizations traveling together.

items.question: Can I rent for multiple days or longer?
items.answer: Yes. Multi-day, weekly and longer rentals may be available, subject to current availability and qualification.

items.question: Can professional drivers rent these vans?
items.answer: Longer-term rentals may be available for qualified professional drivers. Platform eligibility depends on the platform, market, vehicle and current requirements.

items.question: Do you work with concierge companies?
items.answer: Yes. Hospitality and concierge partners can inquire about recurring or group transportation rental needs.

items.question: Can I consign my passenger van with Rent With Heldy?
items.answer: Rent With Heldy works with select vehicle owners. Submit the vehicle through the consignment inquiry for review.
